name: Filter by Profile Type
description:
Verify filtering links by Profile Type using search.

        Steps:
        1. Open "Filter" and select a profile type
        2. Click "Apply"
        3. Search for a name of a DIFFERENT profile type
        4. Verify no results found (record is filtered out)
        5. Search for a name of the CORRECT profile type
        6. Verify record is found (record is NOT filtered out)
        7. Click "Filter" -> "Reset"
        8. Search for the DIFFERENT profile type's name again
        9. Verify record is now found (filter is cleared)
